name: Lazaro Kawer
intro: I build evaluation systems, applied machine learning, and the software that puts them to work.
biography: I'm a Senior Research Engineer and AI Evaluation Lead in Windows Fundamentals at Microsoft. My work spans production AI evaluation, predictive machine learning, and statistical systems for engineering decisions.

Before Microsoft, I worked on recommender and data systems as an AI/ML engineering intern on Apple's Siri Search team, and on infrastructure for Google Search and Cloud as a software engineering intern.

I studied computer science at ITESM Monterrey. My technical interests include model evaluation, agent reliability, forecasting, and the relationship between a system's measured behavior and its behavior in use.
